  F=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-kanareika.conf

  printf 'PasswordAuthentication no\nChallengeResponseAuthentication no\n' > "$F"; echo "$F" > "$B/written"
else
  # no drop-ins (e.g. CentOS 7): sshd takes the FIRST value, so put ours at the top
  { printf '# kanareika begin\nPasswordAuthentication no\nChallengeResponseAuthentication no\n# kanareika end\n'; cat "$B/sshd_config"; } > /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  echo /etc/ssh/sshd_config > "$B/written"

else rm -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-kanareika.conf; fi
sshd -t && { systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload ssh; }

reboot.apply:

echo "running: $(cat "$B/running")  ->  after reboot: $(cat "$B/default")"

  docker service ls -q | xargs -r docker service inspect --format '{{.Spec.Name}} {{.Spec.TaskTemplate.RestartPolicy.Condition}}'     | awk '$2 != "any" {print "WARNING: " $1 " restart_policy=" $2 " - may stay down after reboot: docker service update --force " $1}'

vendor_users.apply:
for p in '' 'a b' bash 'lib'"'"'quote' libstdc++6 openssl; do
  dpkg -L "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.so(\.|$)|/s?bin/|/libexec/' > "$B/$p.files"
  pids=$(for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do { readlink "$d/exe"; awk '{print $6}' "$d/maps"; } 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -f "$B/$p.files" && echo "${d#/proc/}"; done)
  echo "== $p: $(echo $pids | wc -w) processes"
  [ -n "$pids" ] && ps -o comm= -p $(echo $pids | tr ' ' ,) | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -15
done; true

kernel.apply:
uname -r > "$B/running"
apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y --only-upgrade 'linux-image-*'
echo "REBOOT REQUIRED (not done automatically): systemctl reboot"
kernel.rollback: echo "boot the previous kernel ($(cat "$B/running")) from the GRUB menu (Advanced options)"

reboot.apply:
uname -r > "$B/running"; ls -t /boot/vmlinuz-* | head -1 > "$B/default" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "running: $(cat "$B/running")  ->  after reboot: $(cat "$B/default")"
if docker info --format '{{.Swarm.ControlAvailable}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q true; then
  docker service ls -q | xargs -r docker service inspect --format '{{.Spec.Name}} {{.Spec.TaskTemplate.RestartPolicy.Condition}}'     | awk '$2 != "any" {print "WARNING: " $1 " restart_policy=" $2 " - may stay down after reboot: docker service update --force " $1}'
  docker service ls --format '{{.Name}} {{.Replicas}}' > "$B/services_before"
fi
echo "REBOOT (not done automatically): systemctl reboot"
reboot.rollback: [ -s "$B/running" ] && echo "previous kernel: $(cat "$B/running") - pick it in GRUB or: grubby --set-default /boot/vmlinuz-$(cat "$B/running")"
reboot.verify:
echo "running: $(uname -r)"
docker info --format '{{.Swarm.ControlAvailable}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q true &&   docker service ls --format '{{.Name}} {{.Replicas}}' | awk '{split($2, r, "/"); if (r[1] != r[2]) print "NOT RUNNING: " $0}'; true

os.verify: dpkg-query -W '' 'a b' bash 'lib'"'"'quote' libstdc++6 openssl | head -50

true

vendor_users.apply:
for p in '' 'a b' bash 'lib'"'"'quote' libstdc++6 openssl; do
  dpkg -L "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.so(\.|$)|/s?bin/|/libexec/' > "$B/$p.files"
  pids=$(for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do { readlink "$d/exe"; awk '{print $6}' "$d/maps"; } 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -f "$B/$p.files" && echo "${d#/proc/}"; done)
  echo "== $p: $(echo $pids | wc -w) processes"
  [ -n "$pids" ] && ps -o comm= -p $(echo $pids | tr ' ' ,) | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -15
done; true

disable.apply:
for u in rsyncd.socket rsyncd.service; do systemctl is-enabled "$u" 2>/dev/null | grep -q enabled && echo "$u" >> "$B/enabled"; done
for u in rsyncd.socket rsyncd.service; do systemctl is-active "$u" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^active' && echo "$u" >> "$B/active"; done
if [ -s "$B/enabled" ] || [ -s "$B/active" ]; then systemctl disable --now rsyncd.socket rsyncd.service 2>/dev/null; echo "stopped: $(cat "$B/enabled" "$B/active" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
else echo "rsync / rsync-daemon: service not running — nothing to stop (only the client part is installed)"; fi
disable.rollback:
[ -s "$B/enabled" ] && xargs -r systemctl enable < "$B/enabled"
[ -s "$B/active" ] && xargs -r systemctl start < "$B/active"; true
disable.verify: systemctl is-active rsyncd.socket rsyncd.service 2>/dev/null | paste -sd' '; true
